name: model-routing-gate
description: Fail-closed model assignment and runtime model attestation for Codex subagents

interface.shortDescription: Enforce and attest subagent model assignments.
interface.longDescription: Blocks inherited or missing subagent assignments, correlates launch requests with runtime model evidence, and prevents inadmissible agent output from being collected.
interface.defaultPrompt: Route subagents through the Model Routing Gate.
